text: {"bull":[{"point":"Consolidated revenue grew 17.9% YoY to ₹10,542 crore in Jun 2026 with PAT expanding 39.6% YoY to ₹1,559 crore.","cite":{"table":"Jun 2026 reported"}},{"point":"Q1 FY27 standalone PBDIT margin reached 22%, with consolidated PBDIT margin rising 240 bps YoY to 20.6%.","cite":{"page":16,"quarter":"Q1 FY27"}},{"point":"Strong cash conversion with 5-year operating cash flow at 109% of profit and working-capital days shortening by 16 days.","cite":{"table":"Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 109% of reported profit"}},{"point":"Industrial coatings JV PPGAP grew 17% in Q3 FY26, while new products contributed 16% to overall revenues.","cite":{"page":21,"quarter":"Q3 FY26"}}],"bear":[{"point":"Top-line growth has decelerated significantly, with 3-year revenue CAGR at 1% compared to 10% over 5 years.","cite":{"table":"Revenue grew 1% a year over 3 years vs 10% over 5"}},{"point":"Input cost inflation of 25% poses gross margin compression risks relative to price hikes of only 9-10%.","cite":{"page":23,"quarter":"Q1 FY27"}},{"point":"Discounting remains intense among market competitors, raising concerns over sustaining the 18-20% PBDIT margin guidance.","cite":{"page":23,"quarter":"Q4 FY26"}},{"point":"Debt to equity ratio increased to 0.18 while committed capital expenditure for VAM-VAE reached ₹3,250 crore.","cite":{"page":12,"quarter":"Q2 FY26"}}],"watch":["Commissioning and operational performance of Phase 1 of the VAM-VAE project.","Consolidated PBDIT margin staying within the guided band of 18-20%.","Decorative business volume growth achieving the targeted 8-10% range."]}
